title: OKX referral code benefits: the honest answer

scenes.title: OKX referral code benefits
scenes.sub: What you get, and what you don't

lines.show: Using an OKX referral code can make you eligible for the OKX new user program.
But it doesn't change your fees.

scenes.title: Do you get rewards?
scenes.text: It depends on the current program.

scenes.title: Read the rewards page
scenes.text: Offers come with tasks and terms.

lines.show: Welcome rewards change over time and come with their own tasks.
The app's rewards page shows what's live and the terms.

scenes.title: Are fees lower with a code?

lines.show: And does a code lower your trading fees?
Don't count on it. Fees follow the official fee page and your account tier.
If you'd like a code to use, it's XOACPQFC.
Enter it on the sign-up screen.

scenes.title: If OKX is available where you live

lines.show: If OKX is available where you live, use code XOACPQFC, then check the rewards page.
